views.rationale: AMZN's sales and operating results will fluctuate due to factors such as retaining and increasing sales to existing customers, while BAC's net income decreased due to lower revenue and higher noninterest expense.
BA's cost of sales as a percentage of Revenues decreased by 2.2% YoY, while CAT's cost of sales as a percentage of Revenues increased by 1.4% YoY.

CVX's sales and other operating revenues decreased mainly due to lower refined product and crude oil prices, but the company's refining and chemicals segment saw a 3% increase in sales and other operating revenues.
GOOGL's cost of revenues increased 10% YoY, while GS's net revenue declined 69% YoY.
KO's net operating revenues increased 6% YoY, driven by volume growth, while LIN's sales decreased 2% YoY.
JNJ's sales increased 6.9% YoY, while JPM's net revenue declined 69% YoY.
NVDA's gross profit margin increased to 72.4% from 75.1%, while MSFT's gross margin increased to 193,893 from 171,008.
PG's gross margin decreased 20 basis points to 51.2%, while UNH's gross margin increased to 51.4% from 51.2%.
